description: This file defines an Angular component named 'LoadProgressComponent' used to display a loading indicator with progress, including a spinner icon, a progress bar, and a message.

classes.name: LoadProgressComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that displays a loading progress indicator with optional determinate progress and message.

methods.name: canUpdateComponent
methods.description: A static method that determines whether the component can be updated based on the last update timestamp, to limit UI update frequency.
